categories.title: Portal
categories.info: After completing [Hyrule Castle](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214551), use these portals to alternate between Hyrule and Lorule.

categories.title: Weather Vane
categories.info: Weather Vanes are saving and warping points across the land.

categories.title: Heart Piece
categories.info: Collect 4 Heart Pieces to gain a Heart Container.

categories.title: Maiamai
categories.info: After talking to [Mother Maiamai](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214603), capture lost maimais to gain gear upgrades.

categories.title: Master Ore
categories.info: Can be given to the [Blacksmith](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214639) to upgrade the [Master Sword](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=215148)

categories.title: Sage Painting
categories.info: After clearing [Hyrule Castle](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214551), find all 7 Sage Paintings to progress the game.

categories.title: Empty Bottle
categories.info: Allows for carrying and storing bugs, fairies, fruits and more.

categories.title: Gear
categories.info:
Rent or purchase gear at [Ravio's Shop](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214595).  
Upgrade purchased gear at [Mother Maiamai](https://mapgenie.io/zelda-a-link-between-worlds/maps/hyrule-lorule?locationIds=214603) for 10 Lost Maiamais.
